description: Reviewed Rootara trait locus registry; runtime use requires status=verified.

orientationResolution.rationale: The cited association reports rs11803731-A and its reported frequency matches the GRCh38 forward A allele.
The cited association reports rs11855415-A; Ensembl maps the reviewed locus to forward A/T.
The PEMT -744 G>C study nomenclature and forward C/G mapping support C as the higher-requirement allele; the prior synthetic C/T pair was invalid.
The cited telomere-length association and committed forward C/G mapping report G as the decreasing allele.
The cited hair-color association and GRCh38 forward C/G mapping report G as the effect allele.
The BCMO1 study directly reports the rs12934922 A/T conversion association; A is retained as the higher-conversion allele.
The cited optic-disc association and Ensembl strand=1 C/G mapping report C as the increasing allele.
The cited periodontitis association reports rs1537415-G on the reviewed forward C/G locus.
The cited pigmentation association reports rs16891982-C on the reviewed forward C/G locus.
The MMP1 1G/2G promoter polymorphism is represented by the input platforms as D/I; the prior synthetic A/G formula was invalid.
The ACE insertion/deletion study and vendor encoding directly use D/I genotypes.
HFE H63D is the directly reviewed C/G locus; G is the effect allele used by the transparent rule.
The TCN2 C776G study nomenclature supports the reviewed C/G mapping and G effect allele.
The cited transferrin association reports rs1830084-A; the prior synthetic A/G pair was invalid.
The cited YKL-40 association reports G on the reviewed forward C/G locus.

assemblyResolution.rationale: UCSC hg19 dbSNP151 independently places rs495828 on the positive strand at chr9:136154867 with G/T alleles; the current Ensembl GRCh37 endpoint omits this historical placement.
